candidates.claim: `tprod_nonneg` assumes `[L.NeBot]`, but the statement does not need it: for the trivial summation filter `tprod` is `1` (by `tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable`, and in fact `multipliable_bot` holds there) resp. `∏ᶠ x, f x` (by `tprod_bot`), and `0 ≤ 1` / `0 ≤ ∏ᶠ x, f x` both hold under the same hypotheses. Every other `∏'`-level order lemma in this file drops `L.NeBot` by case-splitting precisely for this reason — `tprod_le_of_prod_le'` (line 149), `one_le_tprod` (line 168), `tprod_le_one` (line 176) — so as stated the new lemma is the only one that cannot be applied when `L` is trivial, and its `by_cases h : Multipliable f L` split is vacuous in that regime (since `¬ L.NeBot` forces `Multipliable f L`). Note also that the additive analogue `tsum_nonneg` (the `to_additive` image of `one_le_tprod`) is used throughout the library without an `NeBot` argument.

Drop `[L.NeBot]` from the statement and cover the trivial filter, in the style of `one_le_tprod`:

```lean
theorem tprod_nonneg [CommMonoidWithZero α] [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]
    [PosMulMono α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : ι → α} (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) :
    0 ≤ ∏'[L] x, f x := by
  by_cases h : Multipliable f L
  · by_cases hL : L.NeBot
    · exact ge_of_tendsto' h.hasProd fun s ↦ s.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i
    · rw [tprod_bot hL]
      exact finprod_induction _ zero_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ mul_nonzero) hf
  · simp [tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable h]
```
(this exact proof was compiled, with `mul_nonneg` in place of the typo `mul_nonzero`).

candidates.claim: The module docstring of the new file is defective: its title `# Modules over presheaves commutative rings` is missing a word (should read "over presheaves of commutative rings"), and the docstring never names the file's main declaration `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing` nor records the fact that makes the whole file work -- that it is definitionally `PresheafOfModules.{v} (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)`, so that the entire `PresheafOfModules` API applies unchanged (this is exactly the design used at `AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Presheaf.lean`, where `Scheme.PresheafOfModules := PresheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf.obj`).
candidates.requested_change: Fix the title to `# Modules over presheaves of commutative rings`, and extend the docstring: mention `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing` explicitly and add a short "## Main definitions" list for the abbreviations, with one sentence stating that `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing R` is `PresheafOfModules (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)` and hence the general API applies as is.
